title: Editorial Plan
description: Front matter contract for a post planning file under editorial/plans/. Validates lifecycle metadata only, not the 14-section body (that structure is owned by the post-planning skill/template, not this schema).

id.description: Stable identifier, POST-PLAN-YYYY-NNN. NNN increments per year, checked against existing files before generation.

slug.description: URL slug once known. Historical plans may not have one recorded; use null, not invented.

created_at.description: Must match the YYYY-MM of the file's own path (validated by the script, not by the schema alone).

schema_version.description: Schema contract version this document conforms to, e.g. 1.0. Bump on breaking changes; never rewrite historical plans silently.

source_skill.description: Which skill/process produced this plan. Not a closed enum on purpose: origin can predate the current skill name or come from a future source_type layer (see source_type).

source_type.description: Which of the two legitimate editorial origins (prompt spec section 15) this plan came from. Optional: not present in historical plans, do not backfill by guessing.

source_refs.description: Real file paths, case IDs, commits or audit references backing the plan. Never invented examples.

canonical_content.description: Slug/ID/URL of the published content once canonical_content applies (status published). CMS is the source of truth, this is a pointer, not a copy.

publication_receipt.description: publication_id of the matching editorial/receipts/ record (editorial/schema/publication-receipt.schema.json), once one exists. Null for every plan today - Fase E shipped the contract, but no plan has gone through a real, receipted CMS publication yet.

human_review_required.description: Must be true before a plan with contains_sensitive_content: true can advance past researching/planned/drafting.

experiment_id.description: Fase F (Capital Agent integration, prompt §7/§21). Capital Agent's own experiment identifier - this repo never assigns or interprets it, only carries it through. Null for every plan today: no real Capital Agent integration exists in code yet (design-doc-only), so any non-null value here would be fabricated.

publication_request_id.description: Fase F. Reference to an external Publication Package (prompt §17), when content originates from one. The existence of a request never authorizes publication by itself - editorial authority stays human/platform (prompt §17, §21).

business_signal_id.description: Fase F. Pseudonymous reference to a BusinessSignal the Capital Agent provided as input to this plan's hypothesis (market-signal origin, source_type). Never a raw signal payload - just an id Capital Agent can correlate on its own side.

opportunity_id.description: Fase F. Pseudonymous reference to an OpportunityCandidate the Capital Agent provided, same rule as business_signal_id.

outcome_ref.description: outcome_id of the matching editorial/outcomes/ record, once one exists for this plan. Null for every plan today, same reason as publication_receipt.
